chunks: Never did We send a messenger before you but through a man, whom We inspired. If you do not know, then ask the keepers of the oracles of God.
ai.seo_question: Who are Ahl al-Dhikr mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Anbiya establishes that all prophets sent by God were human men inspired with revelation, distinguishing them from angels or divine beings. It instructs those who lack knowledge to refer to 'Ahl al-Dhikr' (the people of remembrance/knowledge) for guidance, a concept central to Shia exegesis for identifying the Imams. Shia scholars, including Al-Tabarsi and Al-Qummi, interpret 'Ahl al-Dhikr' specifically as the Ahl al-Bayt, viewing them as the living repository of divine knowledge and the authoritative interpreters of the Quran after the Prophet.
